up.flap.info: Each takeoff pops you higher. The faster you leave the hill, the bigger the boost, so a well-timed release at the bottom of a valley sends you much higher.
up.slide.info: Holding on downhills speeds you up faster, and less drag on the snow raises your top speed.
up.magnet.info: Pulls fish around the penguin toward you. Each level reaches fish farther away.
up.glide.info: While you're not holding on the way down, you fall more gently and the air slows you less, so you fly farther.
up.scarf.info: When the blizzard catches you, your scarf holds on and you burst forward. Works as many times per run as your Escapes count.
